description: DiligenceOps: submit a purchase record (amount, currency, purchase and delivery dates, item, condition, final sale) and the merchant’s refund policy text, with an optional request date and the evidence on hand. The signed report says whether a refund claim fits the policy as written, shows the deadline arithmetic step by step, and lists item conditions, exclusions, fees, the remedy and the evidence the policy expects attached. POST /api/refund-eligibility-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/diligence-checks-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

evidence_available.description: Evidence the buyer can attach, for example ["receipt", "photos"].

requested_at.description: When the refund is or was requested. Defaults to the check time.

policy.description: The merchant’s refund or return policy text, up to 256 KB.

amount.description: A non-negative amount as a decimal string or number, up to 6 places, for example "49.99".

condition.description: The item’s condition or the problem with it.

currency.description: Currency or token code, for example USD, EUR or USDC.

delivered_at.description: ISO date (2026-11-04) or datetime with a timezone (2026-11-04T17:00:00Z).

final_sale.description: true when the item was sold as final sale.

purchased_at.description: ISO date (2026-11-04) or datetime with a timezone (2026-11-04T17:00:00Z).

name: wever_refund-eligibility-check
title: Refund eligibility check
